meta.name: geopandas
meta.description: Guidance and local audit tools for Python workflows that directly use GeoPandas GeoSeries, GeoDataFrame, spatial operations, or vector-data I/O.

copy.tagline: 处理地理数据时,本地检查并给出操作指导
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常用 Python 分析带地理坐标的数据,需要确保操作正确。
copy.tagline_en: Run local audits and get guidance on geospatial data handling
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often analyze geographic data in Python and want to keep your methods correct.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用 GeoPandas 处理矢量地理数据：读写 Shapefile、GeoJSON、GeoPackage、PostGIS，做缓冲区、空间连接、叠加、融合、投影转换、面积距离计算，并绘制地图。
howto.when: 当你处理矢量地理数据，需要做空间分析、坐标转换、绘图等任务，或读写 Shapefile、GeoJSON 等格式时触发。

say.text: 读取 data.geojson，看看有哪些字段和坐标系
say.note: 会读取文件并打印基本信息

say.text: 把这两个图层按相交关系做空间连接
say.note: 用 sjoin 输出连接结果

say.text: 按人口字段画分级设色地图并导出
say.note: 生成静态或交互式地图

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude works with vector geospatial data via GeoPandas: reading/writing Shapefile, GeoJSON, GeoPackage and PostGIS, doing buffers, spatial joins, overlays, dissolve, reprojection, area/distance math, and plotting maps.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you work with vector geographic data: spatial analysis, coordinate transformation, mapping, or reading/writing formats such as Shapefile and GeoJSON.

say_en.text: Read data.geojson and show its fields and CRS
say_en.note: Prints basic info about the file

say_en.text: Spatially join these two layers by intersection
say_en.note: Runs sjoin and returns joined rows

say_en.text: Plot a choropleth map by the population column
say_en.note: Renders a static or interactive map
